newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan holds two Iranian border force officers.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan holds two Iranian border force officers.

text.p: Pakistani border police have arrested two officers of the Iranian border security force for crossing the border wihtout permission, Pakistani official sources said on Wednesday.

The two men, identified only as Ali and Saeed, were arrested on Tuesday evening at the border town of Taftan, a Pakistani official there said. A Kalashnikov assault rifle and a wireless set were recovered from them.
Negotiations were under way on Wednesday for the release of the two officers after Iranian authorities contacted their Pakistani counterparts, the official said.
